description: Pre-registered 80-dps proton-pinned benchmark of the derived G2 isospin step (IsospinTwistWrithe #9747 writhe arms e = 0, A-1, 3 floor(A/2), 3A(3A-1) and IsospinWeightMultiplicity down-quark weight count C(3A, Z+2N)) combined with the G3 Coulomb step (two labelled #9866 cell-radius arms c = 1 and c^3 = 3/2, derived #9699 shape factor) across all 1,009 composite AME2020 beta-minus transitions (ACCURACY.md Table 3.4b). Lean companion: QOU/Nuclear/IsobaricBetaWritheCoulombStep.lean. Zero free parameters; AME2020 comparison only; no arm selected.

structural_diagnosis.gamma_gamma_word_writhe: Identically 0 (IsospinTwistWrithe bb1d29c6df6), so the braid-channel log-determinant T(T+1) step vanishes on ruled gamma-gamma words.
structural_diagnosis.mirror_doublet_d_eq_1: ttStepInt(1) = 0 and C(3A, n_d - 1) = C(3A, n_d) at N_parent = Z + 1 (e.g. 3H -> 3He), so every mirror beta-minus transition shifts purely by the Coulomb displacement -Z * eps_c(A).
structural_diagnosis.scale_mismatch_between_G2_and_G3: G2 writhe (chain e=A-1: <= 2*kappa/(9A) ~ 0.17/A MeV) and weight-multiplicity (~(alpha/6)(N-Z)^2/A ~ 0.624*(N-Z)^2/A MeV) sit at the 1D proxy scale alpha = 8*G*m_e (~37x below classical ~23 MeV symmetry energy), whereas G3 Coulomb (-Z*eps_c(A)) carries the full CAL-3 electromagnetic scale. Wiring G3 into mass_table_comprehensive without closing the strong/symmetry scale (G5) drives heavy beta-minus transitions endothermic; G2 weight-multiplicity alone keeps 1,009/1,009 exothermic and lowers median |dQ|/Q from 92.69% to 84.26%.
